ko.title: 심층 타격, 얕은 대화: 트럼프의 젤렌스키 앙카라 회담이 모스크바를 움직이지 못한 이유

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## 상징적인 악수, 돌파구는 아니었다

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: 앙카라에서 열린 최근의 NATO summit에서, 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령과 자리를 함께하며 헤드라인을 장식했지만, 회담 내용을 보고받은 관계자들에 따르면 새로운 조건에 대해서는 거의 진전이 없었습니다.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: 보도에 따르면 트럼프 대통령은 우크라이나가 러시아 영토 깊숙이 가한 장거리 타격을 진정한 전장 레버리지의 원천으로 규정하며, 러시아의 인프라와 물류에 가해지는 압박이 결국 모스크바를 키이우에 더 유리한 조건으로 협상 테이블로 밀어낼 수 있다고 시사했습니다.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: 이는 지난 1년의 대부분을 양측에 신속한 휴전을 촉구하며 보낸 대통령으로서 주목할 만한 어조의 변화였습니다.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: 하지만 논의 내용을 잘 아는 외교관들에 따르면, 이번 회담은 구체적인 프레임워크보다는 격려 차원의 성격이 강했으며, 이전의 모든 휴전 시도를 무산시킨 핵심 분쟁 사항은 여전히 해결되지 않은 채로 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## 변하지 않은 쟁점

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: 그 분쟁은 바로 돈바스 지역의 지위 문제입니다.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: 러시아 협상가들은 지속적으로 어떤 지속 가능한 합의에도 우크라이나가 도네츠크와 루한스크의 나머지 우크라이나 점유 지역을 공식적으로 양도해야 한다는 신호를 보냈습니다. 이 지역은 모스크바가 이미 병합했다고 주장하지만 군사적으로 완전히 통제하지 못하고 있는 영토입니다.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: 키이우는 마찬가지로 일관되게 그 요구를 거부해 왔으며, 우크라이나군이 수년간 방어해 온 도시들을 포함하여 점령되지 않은 요새화된 영토를 포기하는 것은 헌법적 및 전략적 레드라인이 될 것이라고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: 협상을 추적하는 분석가들은 이것이 2026년 유럽 중재 제안부터 걸프 지역 중재자들을 통한 비공식 채널에 이르기까지 거의 모든 휴전 프레임워크를 무너뜨린 단층선이라고 말합니다.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: 장거리 타격이 아무리 극적이라 할지라도, 그 기본적인 방정식은 바꾸지 못했습니다.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "전장 압박은 협상의 속도를 바꿀 수 있습니다,"라고 유럽 기반의 한 보안 분석가가 말했습니다.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "하지만 각 측이 얻어내야 한다고 말하는 실질적인 내용은 바꾸지 못했습니다."

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## 타격만으로는 레버리지로 이어지지 않는 이유

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: 우크라이나가 러시아 내부의 정유소, 창고 및 물류 허브에 대해 장거리 드론과 미사일을 확대 사용한 것은 부인할 수 없이 모스크바의 비용을 증가시켰고 에너지 부문의 일부를 혼란에 빠뜨렸습니다.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: 앙카라에서 트럼프 대통령의 발언은 이러한 캠페인을 억제해야 할 에스컬레이션이 아니라 정당한 협상 도구로 지지하는 것처럼 보였으며, 이는 러시아 영토 깊숙이 가해지는 타격을 자제해 달라고 촉구했던 이전의 백악관 메시지와는 눈에 띄게 다른 점이었습니다.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: 하지만 우크라이나와 러시아 양측 관계자들은 이러한 변화에 너무 많은 의미를 부여하는 것을 경계하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: 러시아 국영 매체와 관계자들은 이번 정상회담을 과소평가하며, 이러한 타격이 협상 지위를 약화시키기보다는 국내적 결속력을 강화하는 공격이라고 규정했습니다.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: 크렘린궁 대변인들은 영토 문제는 "협상 불가능한 시작점"이며, 전장 모멘텀에 따라 달라지는 제안이 아니라고 거듭 강조했습니다.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: 한편, 우크라이나 관계자들은 트럼프 대통령의 수사적 지지를 환영했지만, 그것이 실제로 무엇을 의미하는지에 대해 과장하지 않도록 주의했습니다.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: 키이우는 어떤 영토적 타협의 조건으로 잠재적인 NATO 인접 약속이나 양자 국방 조약을 통한 더 확고한 보안 보장을 계속해서 추구하고 있으며, 이 요구는 지금까지 동맹국들 사이에서도 합의에 이르지 못했습니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 전망

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 앙카라 회담이 새로운 협상 트랙의 시작이라기보다는 워싱턴과 키이우 사이의 정렬 신호로 더 많이 작용하는 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: 외교관들은 앞으로 몇 주 안에 후속 협상이 있을 가능성이 높으며, 여기에는 러시아와 우크라이나 대표단 사이의 이전 간접 접촉을 주최했던 유럽과 터키 중재자들이 참여할 가능성이 있다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: 돈바스 문제가 양국 정부가 국내적으로 정당화할 수 있는 어떤 공식으로 정면으로 다뤄지기 전까지는, 관계자들과 분석가들은 앙카라 회담과 같은 고위급 외교적 순간들이 헤드라인을 장식할 수는 있어도, 일 년 내내 협상가들을 피해 갔던 지속 가능한 휴전 프레임워크를 만들어내지는 못할 것이라는 점에 대체로 동의합니다.

zh.title: 深层打击，浅层对话：为何特朗普在安卡拉与泽连斯基的会晤未能撼动莫斯科

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## 一个象征性的握手，而非突破

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: 在安卡拉举行的最新一次北约峰会期间，唐纳德·特朗普总统与乌克兰总统泽连斯基举行了会晤。这次会晤虽然占据了新闻头条，但据听取简报的官员称，在达成新条款方面几乎没有进展。

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: 据报道，特朗普将乌克兰对俄罗斯领土深处的远程打击视为真正的战场筹码，暗示对俄罗斯基础设施和物流的压力最终可能迫使莫斯科在更有利于基辅的条件下回到谈判桌前。

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: 对于一位在过去一年大部分时间里一直敦促双方迅速停火的总统来说，这在语气上是一个显著的转变。

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: 然而，据熟悉讨论情况的外交官称，这次会晤产生的是鼓励而非具体的框架——而导致之前每次停火尝试失败的核心争议仍然没有触及。

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## 僵局依然未变

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: 该争议点在于顿巴斯的地位。

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: 俄罗斯谈判代表一直发出信号，认为任何持久的解决方案都要求乌克兰正式放弃由乌克兰控制的顿涅茨克和卢甘斯克剩余部分，莫斯科已声称这些领土被兼并，但在军事上尚未完全控制。

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: 基辅同样坚定地拒绝了这一要求，认为放弃尚未被占领且经过防御工事加固的领土——包括乌克兰军队防守多年的城市——将是宪法和战略上的红线。

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: 跟踪谈判的分析人士表示，这是导致 2026 年几乎所有提出的停火框架破产的断裂线，从欧洲斡旋的提案到涉及海湾国家调解人的非正式渠道。

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: 远程打击无论多么剧烈，都没有改变这个基本方程式。

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: “战场压力可以改变谈判的节奏，”一位驻欧安全分析人士表示。

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: “但它没有改变各方声称必须达成的实质性结果。”

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## 为何仅靠打击无法转化为筹码

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: 乌克兰扩大对俄罗斯境内炼油厂、仓库和物流枢纽使用远程无人机和导弹的行动，不可否认地增加了莫斯科的成本并扰乱了其能源部门的部分环节。

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: 特朗普在安卡拉的言论似乎将该行动认可为一种合法的谈判工具，而非应当被遏制的升级行为——这与白宫早前敦促对俄罗斯领土深处打击保持克制的措辞截然不同。

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: 但乌克兰和俄罗斯双方的官员都警告不要过度解读这一转变。

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: 俄罗斯国家媒体和官员淡化了这次峰会会晤，将这些打击描述为增强国内决心的攻击，而非削弱谈判地位的攻击。

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: 克里姆林宫发言人重申，领土问题是“不可谈判的起点”，而非取决于战场势头的开价。

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: 与此同时，乌克兰官员欢迎特朗普在措辞上的支持，但谨慎地没有过度夸大其在实践中的意义。

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: 基辅继续寻求更坚实的安全保证——潜在的类北约承诺或双边防御协议——作为任何领土妥协的条件，这一要求至今在盟友之间也未达成共识。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来的走向

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: 目前，安卡拉会晤似乎更多地是作为华盛顿和基辅之间一致性的信号，而非新谈判轨道的开始。

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: 外交官表示，未来几周可能会有后续谈判，可能会涉及之前主持过俄乌代表团间接接触的欧洲和土耳其调解人。

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: 在顿巴斯问题被正面解决之前——通过某种两国政府都能在国内交代的方案——官员和分析人士普遍认为，即使是像安卡拉这样高调的外交时刻，也可能仅产生新闻头条，而无法产生那种在一年中一直让谈判者难以企及的持久停火框架。

segments.tr: खबरों के अनुसार, ट्रम्प ने रूसी क्षेत्र में गहराई तक यूक्रेन के लंबी दूरी के प्रहारों को वास्तविक युद्धक्षेत्र लाभ के स्रोत के रूप में पेश किया, यह सुझाव देते हुए कि रूसी बुनियादी ढांचे और रसद पर दबाव डालने से अंततः मॉस्को को उन शर्तों पर बातचीत की मेज पर लाया जा सकता है जो कीव के लिए अधिक अनुकूल हों।

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: यह उस राष्ट्रपति की ओर से लहजे में एक उल्लेखनीय बदलाव था, जिन्होंने पिछले साल का अधिकांश समय दोनों पक्षों को तेजी से युद्धविराम के लिए प्रेरित करने में बिताया था।

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: फिर भी, चर्चाओं से परिचित राजनयिकों के अनुसार, बैठक ने एक ठोस ढांचे के बजाय प्रोत्साहन दिया — और वह मुख्य विवाद जो पिछले हर प्रयास को विफल कर चुका है, वह अभी भी अनसुलझा है।

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## मुख्य विवाद बिंदु नहीं बदला है

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: वह विवाद डोनबास की स्थिति का है।

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: रूसी वार्ताकारों ने लगातार संकेत दिया है कि किसी भी स्थायी समाधान के लिए यूक्रेन को औपचारिक रूप से डोनेट्स्क और लुहान्स्क के शेष यूक्रेनी-नियंत्रित हिस्सों को छोड़ना होगा, वह क्षेत्र जिसे मॉस्को पहले ही अनुलग्न किया हुआ दावा करता है लेकिन सैन्य रूप से पूरी तरह से नियंत्रित नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: कीव ने भी उतनी ही निरंतरता के साथ उस मांग को खारिज कर दिया है, यह तर्क देते हुए कि अनकब्जे वाले, किलेबंद क्षेत्र — जिनमें वे शहर शामिल हैं जिनकी यूक्रेनी सेनाओं ने वर्षों तक रक्षा की है — को समर्पित करना संवैधानिक और रणनीतिक रूप से एक 'रेड लाइन' होगी।

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: बातचीत पर नज़र रखने वाले विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि यह वह दरार है जिसने 2026 में पेश किए गए लगभग हर युद्धविराम ढांचे को विफल कर दिया है, यूरोपीय-मध्यस्थ प्रस्तावों से लेकर खाड़ी मध्यस्थों से जुड़े अनौपचारिक चैनलों तक।

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: लंबी दूरी के प्रहार, चाहे कितने भी नाटकीय हों, उस बुनियादी समीकरण को नहीं बदल पाए हैं।

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "युद्धक्षेत्र का दबाव बातचीत की गति को बदल सकता है," यूरोप स्थित एक सुरक्षा विश्लेषक ने कहा।

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "लेकिन इसने उस सार को नहीं बदला है कि प्रत्येक पक्ष को क्या चाहिए ताकि वह पीछे हट सके।"

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## केवल प्रहार लाभ में क्यों नहीं बदलते

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: रूस के भीतर रिफाइनरियों, डिपो और रसद केंद्रों के खिलाफ यूक्रेन द्वारा लंबी दूरी के ड्रोन और मिसाइलों के विस्तारित उपयोग ने निस्संदेह मॉस्को के लिए लागत बढ़ाई है और उसके ऊर्जा क्षेत्र के कुछ हिस्सों को बाधित किया है।

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: अंकारा में ट्रम्प की टिप्पणियों ने उस अभियान को हतोत्साहित करने के बजाय एक वैध सौदेबाजी के उपकरण के रूप में समर्थन दिया प्रतीत होता है — यह व्हाइट हाउस के पिछले संदेशों से एक उल्लेखनीय बदलाव है, जिन्होंने रूसी क्षेत्र के भीतर गहराई तक प्रहारों पर संयम बरतने का आग्रह किया था।

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: लेकिन यूक्रेनी और रूसी दोनों पक्षों के अधिकारी इस बदलाव को बहुत अधिक महत्व देने के प्रति सचेत करते हैं।

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: रूसी राज्य मीडिया और अधिकारियों ने शिखर सम्मेलन की बैठक को कम करके दिखाया है, प्रहारों को ऐसे हमलों के रूप में चित्रित किया है जो बातचीत की स्थिति को कमजोर करने के बजाय घरेलू संकल्प को और मजबूत करते हैं।

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: क्रेमलिन के प्रवक्ताओं ने दोहराया है कि क्षेत्रीय प्रश्न "गैर-परक्राम्य शुरुआती बिंदु" हैं, न कि युद्धक्षेत्र की गति पर आधारित शुरुआती बोलियां।

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: इस बीच, यूक्रेनी अधिकारियों ने ट्रम्प के बयानबाजी के समर्थन का स्वागत किया है लेकिन वे इस बात पर जोर देने से बचते रहे हैं कि व्यवहार में इसका क्या मतलब है।

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: कीव किसी भी क्षेत्रीय समझौते की शर्त के रूप में अधिक मजबूत सुरक्षा गारंटी — संभावित नाटो-संबद्ध प्रतिबद्धताओं या द्विपक्षीय रक्षा समझौतों — की तलाश करना जारी रखता है, एक ऐसी मांग जिसे अब तक सहयोगियों के बीच भी कोई सहमति नहीं मिली है।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, अंकारा बैठक वाशिंगटन और कीव के बीच संरेखण के संकेत के रूप में अधिक कार्य करती है, न कि एक नए बातचीत के ट्रैक की शुरुआत के रूप में।

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: राजनयिकों का कहना है कि आने वाले हफ्तों में अनुवर्ती बातचीत होने की संभावना है, जिसमें संभवतः यूरोपीय और तुर्की मध्यस्थ शामिल होंगे जिन्होंने रूसी और यूक्रेनी प्रतिनिधिमंडलों के बीच पिछले अप्रत्यक्ष संपर्क के दौरों की मेजबानी की है।

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: जब तक डोनबास प्रश्न का सीधे तौर पर समाधान नहीं किया जाता — किसी ऐसे सूत्र के माध्यम से जिसे दोनों सरकारें अपने देश में उचित ठहरा सकें — अधिकारियों और विश्लेषकों का व्यापक रूप से मानना है कि अंकारा जैसी उच्च-प्रोफ़ाइल राजनयिक क्षण भी केवल सुर्खियाँ बटोरेंगे, बिना उस टिकाऊ युद्धविराम ढांचे को उत्पन्न किए जो पूरे वर्ष वार्ताकारों के लिए मायावी रहा है।

es.title: Golpes profundos, conversaciones superficiales: Por qué la reunión de Trump en Ankara con Zelensky no ha conmovido a Moscú

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Un apretón de manos simbólico, no un avance

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: Al margen de la última cumbre de la OTAN en Ankara, el presidente Donald Trump se reunió con el presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelensky en un encuentro que generó titulares, pero que, según funcionarios informados sobre las conversaciones, aportó muy poco en términos de nuevos acuerdos.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Según se informa, Trump planteó los ataques de largo alcance de Ucrania en profundidad en territorio ruso como una fuente de ventaja real en el campo de batalla, sugiriendo que la presión sobre la infraestructura y la logística rusas podría eventualmente empujar a Moscú hacia la mesa de negociaciones en términos más favorables para Kiev.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Fue un cambio notable de tono por parte de un presidente que ha pasado gran parte del último año instando a ambas partes a un cese al fuego rápido.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, según diplomáticos familiarizados con las discusiones, la reunión produjo aliento en lugar de un marco concreto, y la disputa central que ha hundido cada intento previo de tregua permanece intacta.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## El punto muerto no ha cambiado

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Esa disputa es el estatus del Donbás.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Los negociadores rusos han señalado consistentemente que cualquier acuerdo duradero requiere que Ucrania ceda formalmente las partes restantes del Donetsk y Luhansk bajo control ucraniano, territorio que Moscú ya reclama como anexionado pero que no controla totalmente desde el punto de vista militar.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kiev ha rechazado ese demand con la misma consistencia, argumentando que rendir territorio fortificado y no ocupado —incluidas ciudades que las fuerzas ucranianas han defendido durante años— sería una línea roja tanto constitucional como estratégica.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Los analistas que siguen las conversaciones dicen que esta es la falla que ha zozobrado casi todos los marcos de cese al fuego propuestos en 2026, desde propuestas mediadas por Europa hasta canales informales que involucran a mediadores del Golfo.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Los ataques de largo alcance, por muy dramáticos que sean, no han alterado esa ecuación básica.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "La presión en el campo de batalla puede cambiar el ritmo de las conversaciones", dijo un analista de seguridad basado en Europa.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "Pero no ha cambiado la sustancia de lo que cada lado dice que necesita para retirarse".

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Por qué los ataques por sí solos no se traducen en ventaja

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: El uso ampliado de drones y misiles de largo alcance por parte de Ucrania contra refinerías, depósitos y centros logísticos dentro de Rusia ha aumentado innegablemente los costos para Moscú y ha perturbado partes de su sector energético.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Los comentarios de Trump en Ankara parecieron respaldar esa campaña como una herramienta de negociación legítima en lugar de una escalada que deba desalentarse, una desviación notable de los mensajes anteriores de la Casa Blanca que habían instado a la moderación en los ataques profundos en territorio ruso.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Pero los funcionarios de ambos bandos, ucraniano y ruso, advierten que no se lea demasiado en este cambio.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Los medios estatales rusos y los funcionarios han minimizado la reunión de la cumbre, caracterizando los ataques como ofensivas que endurecen la resolución interna en lugar de debilitar las posiciones de negociación.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: Los portavoces del Kremlin han reiterado que las cuestiones territoriales son "puntos de partida no negociables", no ofertas iniciales sujetas al impulso del campo de batalla.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, los funcionarios ucranianos han acogido con satisfacción el apoyo retórico de Trump, pero han sido cuidadosos de no exagerar lo que esto significa en la práctica.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: Kiev sigue buscando garantías de seguridad más firmes —posibles compromisos adyacentes a la OTAN o pactos de defensa bilaterales— como condición para cualquier compromiso territorial, una demanda que hasta ahora no ha encontrado consenso entre los aliados tampoco.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: Por ahora, la reunión de Ankara parece funcionar más como una señal de alineación entre Washington y Kiev que como el inicio de una nueva vía de negociación.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: Los diplomáticos dicen que es probable que haya conversaciones de seguimiento en las próximas semanas, posiblemente involucrando a intermediarios europeos y turcos que han albergado rondas previas de contacto indirecto entre las delegaciones rusa y ucraniana.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Hasta que la cuestión del Donbás se aborde frontalmente —a través de alguna fórmula que ambos gobiernos puedan presentar como defendible en casa— los funcionarios y analistas coinciden ampliamente en que incluso los momentos diplomáticos de alto perfil como el de Ankara probablemente generarán titulares sin producir el tipo de marco de cese al fuego duradero que ha eludido a los negociadores durante todo el año.

segments.tr: وقد رفضت كييف هذا المطلب بنفس القدر من الثبات، معتبرة أن التخلي عن أراضٍ محصنة وغير محتلة - بما في ذلك مدن دافعت عنها القوات الأوكرانية لسنوات - سيكون خطاً أحمر دستورياً واستراتيجياً.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: يقول المحللون الذين يتابعون المحادثات إن هذا هو خط الصدع الذي تسبب في فشل كل إطار عمل لوقف إطلاق النار تقريباً تم طرحه في 2026، من المقترحات التي توسطت فيها أوروبا إلى القنوات غير الرسمية التي شارك فيها وسطاء من الخليج.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: بدت تعليقات ترامب في أنقرة وكأنها تؤيد هذه الحملة كأداة مساومة مشروعة بدلاً من كونها تصعيداً يجب تثبيطه - وهو خروج ملحوظ عن رسائل البيت الأبيض السابقة التي حثت على ضبط النفس في الضربات في عمق الأراضي الروسية.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: لكن المسؤولين من الجانبين الأوكراني والروسي يحذرون من المبالغة في تفسير هذا التحول.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: وأكد المتحدثون باسم الكرملين أن القضايا الإقليمية هي "نقاط بداية غير قابلة للتفاوض"، وليست عروضاً افتتاحية تخضع لزخم ساحة المعركة.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: وفي الوقت نفسه، رحب المسؤولون الأوكرانيون بدعم ترامب البلاغي، لكنهم كانوا حذرين من المبالغة في تقدير ما يعنيه ذلك من الناحية العملية.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يبدو أن اجتماع أنقرة يعمل كإشارة على التوافق بين واشنطن وكييف أكثر من كونه بداية لمسار تفاوضي جديد.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: يقول الدبلوماسيون إن المحادثات المتابعة من المرجح أن تتم في الأسابيع المقبلة، وربما تشمل وسطاء أوروبيين وأتراك استضافوا جولات سابقة من الاتصال غير المباشر بين الوفدين الروسي والأوكراني.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: وحتى يتم التعامل مع مسألة الدونباس بشكل مباشر - من خلال صيغة يمكن للحكومتين تقديمها على أنها قابلة للدفاع عنها داخلياً - يتفق المسؤولون والمحللون بشكل عام على أن حتى اللحظات الدبلوماسية رفيعة المستوى مثل تلك التي حدثت في أنقرة من المرجح أن تثير العناوين الرئيسية دون إنتاج نوع من إطار عمل وقف إطلاق النار الدائم الذي استعصى على المفاوضين طوال العام.

fr.title: Frappes profondes, discussions superficielles : pourquoi la rencontre de Trump avec Zelensky à Ankara n'a pas fait bouger Moscou

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Une poignée de main symbolique, pas une percée

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: En marge du dernier sommet de l'OTAN à Ankara, le président Donald Trump s'est entretenu avec le président ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky lors d'une réunion qui a fait les gros titres, mais qui, selon des responsables informés des discussions, n'a guère apporté de nouveaux termes.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Trump aurait présenté les frappes à longue portée de l'Ukraine profondément dans le territoire russe comme une source de levier réel sur le terrain, suggérant que la pression sur les infrastructures et la logistique russes pourrait éventuellement pousser Moscou vers la table des négociations selon des termes plus favorables à Kiev.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: C'était un changement de ton notable de la part d'un président qui a passé une grande partie de l'année dernière à presser les deux parties vers un cessez-le-feu rapide.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Pourtant, selon des diplomates familiers avec les discussions, la réunion a produit des encouragements plutôt qu'un cadre concret — et le différend central qui a fait échouer chaque tentative précédente de trêve reste intact.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## Le point de blocage n'a pas changé

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Ce différend concerne le statut du Donbass.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Les négociateurs russes ont systématiquement signalé que tout règlement durable exige que l'Ukraine cède formellement les parties restantes de Donetsk et Louhansk détenues par l'Ukraine, territoires que Moscou revendique déjà comme annexés mais qu'elle ne contrôle pas pleinement militairement.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kiev a tout aussi systématiquement rejeté cette exigence, arguant que rendre des territoires fortifiés et non occupés — y compris des villes que les forces ukrainiennes défendent depuis des années — constituerait une ligne rouge tant constitutionnelle que stratégique.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Les analystes qui suivent les discussions affirment que c'est la ligne de fracture qui a fait capoter presque tous les cadres de cessez-le-feu proposés en 2026, des propositions négociées par l'Europe aux canaux informels impliquant des médiateurs du Golfe.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Les frappes à longue portée, aussi spectaculaires soient-elles, n'ont pas modifié cette équation de base.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "La pression sur le terrain peut changer le rythme des discussions", a déclaré un analyste en sécurité basé en Europe.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "Elle n'a pas changé la substance de ce que chaque partie dit avoir besoin d'obtenir pour conclure l'accord."

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les frappes seules ne se traduisent pas en levier

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: L'utilisation accrue par l'Ukraine de drones et de missiles à longue portée contre des raffineries, des dépôts et des centres logistiques à l'intérieur de la Russie a indéniablement augmenté les coûts pour Moscou et perturbé certaines parties de son secteur énergétique.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Les commentaires de Trump à Ankara semblaient cautionner cette campagne comme un outil de négociation légitime plutôt que comme une escalade à décourager — un écart notable par rapport aux messages précédents de la Maison Blanche qui appelaient à la retenue concernant les frappes profondes dans le territoire russe.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Mais les responsables des deux côtés, ukrainien et russe, mettent en garde contre une interprétation excessive de ce changement.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Les médias d'État russes et les responsables ont minimisé la réunion du sommet, qualifiant les frappes d'attaques qui renforcent la détermination nationale plutôt que d'affaiblir les positions de négociation.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: Les porte-paroles du Kremlin ont réitéré que les questions territoriales sont des "points de départ non négociables", et non des offres d'ouverture soumises au momentum du champ de bataille.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, les responsables ukrainiens ont accueilli le soutien rhétorique de Trump, mais ont été prudents de ne pas surestimer ce que cela signifie en pratique.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: Kiev continue de chercher des garanties de sécurité plus fermes — d'éventuels engagements adjacents à l'OTAN ou des pactes de défense bilatéraux — comme condition à tout compromis territorial, une exigence qui n'a jusqu'à présent trouvé aucun consensus parmi les alliés.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la réunion d'Ankara semble fonctionner davantage comme un signal d'alignement entre Washington et Kiev que comme le début d'une nouvelle voie de négociation.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: Les diplomates disent que des discussions de suivi sont probables dans les semaines à venir, impliquant possiblement des intermédiaires européens et turcs qui ont accueilli des rounds précédents de contacts indirects entre les délégations russe et ukrainienne.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Tant que la question du Donbass ne sera pas abordée de front — via une formule que les deux gouvernements peuvent présenter comme défendable chez eux — les responsables et les analystes s'accordent largement pour dire que même des moments diplomatiques de haut profil comme celui d'Ankara sont susceptibles de générer des gros titres sans produire le type de cadre de cessez-le-feu durable qui a échappé aux négociateurs tout au long de l'année.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.

in.title: Serangan Jauh, Pembicaraan Dangkal: Mengapa Pertemuan Trump dengan Zelensky di Ankara Tidak Menggerakkan Moskow

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Jabat Tangan Simbolis, Bukan Terobosan

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: Di sela-sela KTT NATO terbaru di Ankara, Presiden Donald Trump bertemu dengan Presiden Ukraina Volodymyr Zelensky dalam sebuah pertemuan yang menghasilkan berita utama tetapi, menurut para pejabat yang mendapat pengarahan tentang pembicaraan tersebut, memberikan sedikit ketentuan baru.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Trump dilaporkan membingkai serangan jarak jauh Ukraina jauh ke dalam wilayah Rusia sebagai sumber daya tawar medan perang yang nyata, menunjukkan bahwa tekanan pada infrastruktur dan logistik Rusia pada akhirnya dapat mendorong Moskow ke meja perundingan dengan persyaratan yang lebih menguntungkan bagi Kyiv.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Ini merupakan pergeseran nada yang mencolok dari seorang presiden yang telah menghabiskan sebagian besar tahun lalu mendesak kedua belah pihak untuk segera melakukan gencatan senjata.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Namun menurut para diplomat yang mengetahui diskusi tersebut, pertemuan itu menghasilkan dorongan semangat daripada kerangka kerja konkret — dan perselisihan inti yang telah menggagalkan setiap upaya gencatan senjata sebelumnya tetap tidak tersentuh.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## Titik Buntu Tidak Berubah

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Perselisihan tersebut adalah status Donbas.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Negosiator Rusia secara konsisten memberi sinyal bahwa penyelesaian yang langgeng mengharuskan Ukraina untuk secara resmi menyerahkan bagian Donetsk dan Luhansk yang masih dikuasai Ukraina, wilayah yang sudah diklaim Moskow sebagai aneksasi tetapi tidak dikendalikan sepenuhnya secara militer.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kyiv secara konsisten menolak tuntutan tersebut, dengan argumen bahwa menyerahkan wilayah berbenteng yang tidak diduduki — termasuk kota-kota yang telah dipertahankan pasukan Ukraina selama bertahun-tahun — akan menjadi garis merah konstitusional maupun strategis.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Analis yang memantau pembicaraan tersebut mengatakan bahwa inilah garis retakan yang telah menggagalkan hampir setiap kerangka gencatan senjata yang diajukan pada tahun 2026, mulai dari proposal yang diperantarai Eropa hingga saluran informal yang melibatkan mediator Teluk.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Serangan jarak jauh, betapapun dramatisnya, tidak mengubah persamaan dasar tersebut.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "Tekanan medan perang dapat mengubah kecepatan pembicaraan," kata seorang analis keamanan yang berbasis di Eropa.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "Namun hal itu tidak mengubah substansi dari apa yang dikatakan setiap pihak sebagai hal yang harus mereka dapatkan sebelum mengakhiri konflik."

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Serangan Saja Tidak Berarti Daya Tawar

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: Perluasan penggunaan drone dan rudal jarak jauh Ukraina terhadap kilang minyak, depot, dan pusat logistik di dalam Rusia tidak dapat dipungkiri telah meningkatkan biaya bagi Moskow dan mengganggu sebagian sektor energinya.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Komentar Trump di Ankara tampak mendukung kampanye tersebut sebagai alat tawar-menawar yang sah daripada eskalasi yang harus dicegah — sebuah penyimpangan nyata dari pesan Gedung Putih sebelumnya yang mendesak pengendalian serangan jauh ke dalam wilayah Rusia.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Namun pejabat dari pihak Ukraina dan Rusia memperingatkan agar tidak terlalu mengartikan pergeseran tersebut.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Media pemerintah Rusia dan para pejabat meremehkan pertemuan KTT tersebut, mengkarakterisasi serangan-serangan itu sebagai serangan yang justru memperkuat tekad domestik daripada melemahkan posisi perundingan.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: Juru bicara Kremlin menegaskan kembali bahwa pertanyaan teritorial adalah "titik awal yang tidak dapat dinegosiasikan," bukan tawaran pembuka yang tunduk pada momentum medan perang.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, pejabat Ukraina menyambut dukungan retoris Trump tetapi berhati-hati untuk tidak melebih-lebihkan apa artinya dalam praktiknya.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: Kyiv terus mencari jaminan keamanan yang lebih kokoh — potensi komitmen yang berdekatan dengan NATO atau pakta pertahanan bilateral — sebagai syarat bagi kompromi teritorial apa pun, sebuah tuntutan yang sejauh ini juga tidak menemukan konsensus di antara para sekutu.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, pertemuan Ankara tampak lebih berfungsi sebagai sinyal penyelarasan antara Washington dan Kyiv daripada sebagai awal dari jalur negosiasi baru.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: Para diplomat mengatakan pembicaraan lanjutan kemungkinan terjadi dalam beberapa minggu mendatang, kemungkinan melibatkan perantara Eropa dan Turki yang telah menjadi tuan rumah putaran kontak tidak langsung sebelumnya antara delegasi Rusia dan Ukraina.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Hingga masalah Donbas ditangani secara langsung — melalui beberapa formula yang dapat dipresentasikan oleh kedua pemerintah sebagai hal yang dapat dipertahankan di dalam negeri — para pejabat dan analis secara luas setuju bahwa momen diplomatik profil tinggi seperti yang terjadi di Ankara kemungkinan hanya akan menghasilkan berita utama tanpa menghasilkan kerangka gencatan senjata tahan lama yang telah gagal dicapai oleh para negosiator sepanjang tahun.

ja.title: 深層攻撃と浅い対話：トランプのゼレンスキーとのアンカラ会談がモスクワを動かさなかった理由

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## 象徴的な握手であり、突破口ではない

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: アンカラで開催された最新のNATOサミットの傍らで、ドナルド・トランプ大統領はウクライナのウォロディミル・ゼレンスキー大統領と会談し、見出しを飾るものの、会談の内容に詳しい当局者によれば、新たな条件についてはほとんど何も得られなかった。

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: トランプ氏は、ウクライナによるロシア領内深くへの長距離攻撃を、戦場における真のレバレッジ（交渉力）の源泉として位置づけたと伝えられており、ロシアのインフラと物流への圧力が、最終的にモスクワをキエフにとってより有利な条件での交渉テーブルに追い込む可能性があることを示唆した。

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: これは、過去1年間の多くを両側に迅速な停戦を促すことに費やしてきた大統領としての口調の顕著な変化であった。

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: しかし、議論に詳しい外交官によれば、この会談は具体的な枠組みではなく、励ましを生み出したに過ぎず、これまでのあらゆる停戦の試みを頓挫させた核心的な争点は手つかずのままである。

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## 変わらない膠着点

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: その争点とは、ドンバスの地位である。

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: ロシアの交渉官は、永続的な解決には、ウクライナがドネツクとルハンスクのウクライナ保持分を正式に譲渡することが必要であると一貫して示唆してきた。これらの地域は、モスクワがすでに併合を主張しているが、軍事的に完全に制御できていない地域である。

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: キエフは同様に一貫してその要求を拒否しており、ウクライナ軍が長年守り抜いてきた都市を含む、非占領下の要塞化された地域を放棄することは、憲法上および戦略上のレッドライン（譲れない線）になると主張している。

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: 交渉を追跡している分析家たちは、これが2026年に提案された、欧州主導の提案から湾岸諸国の仲介者による非公式なルートまで、ほぼすべての停戦枠組みを崩壊させた断層線であると述べている。

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: 長距離攻撃は、どれほど劇的であっても、その基本的な方程式を変えることはなかった。

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: 「戦場での圧力は、交渉のペースを変えることはできる」と、欧州を拠点とするある安全保障分析家は述べた。

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: 「しかし、各側が最終的に何を得る必要があるかという実質的な内容は変えていない」。

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## なぜ攻撃だけではレバレッジに変換されないのか

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: ウクライナがロシア国内の製油所、貯蔵庫、物流拠点に対して長距離ドローンやミサイルを拡大して使用したことは、間違いなくモスクワにとってのコストを増大させ、エネルギー部門の一部を混乱させた。

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: アンカラでのトランプ氏の発言は、このキャンペーンを、抑制すべきエスカレーションではなく、正当な交渉ツールとして支持しているように見えた。これは、ロシア領内深くへの攻撃を抑制するように促していた以前のホワイトハウスのメッセージングからの顕著な逸脱である。

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: しかし、ウクライナとロシア両側の当局者は、この変化に過剰な意味を読み取ることに対して警告している。

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: ロシアの国営メディアと当局者はサミットでの会談を軽視し、攻撃は交渉上の立場を弱めるのではなく、国内の決意を固める攻撃であると表現した。

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: クレムリンの報道官は、領土問題は「交渉不可能な出発点」であり、戦場の勢いによって左右される開始提示額ではないと繰り返した。

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: 一方、ウクライナの当局者はトランプ氏の言葉による支持を歓迎したが、それが実際には何を意味するかについて誇張しないよう注意深くあった。

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: キエフは、領土上の妥協の条件として、より強固な安全保障上の保証（NATOに近いコミットメントや二国間防衛協定など）を求め続けており、この要求は今のところ、同盟国の間でも合意に至っていない。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起こるか

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: 今のところ、アンカラ会談は新しい交渉ルートの開始というよりも、ワシントンとキエフの足並みを揃えるシグナルとして機能しているようだ。

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: 外交官たちは、今後数週間以内にフォローアップの会談が行われる可能性が高く、そこにはロシアとウクライナの代表団の間で過去に間接的な接触を主導した欧州やトルコの仲介者が関与する可能性があると述べている。

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: ドンバス問題が、両政府が国内で正当化できる形式で正面から対処されない限り、当局者や分析家たちは、アンカラのような注目度の高い外交的瞬間であっても、見出しを飾るだけで、今年一年中交渉官たちが追い求めてきた持続可能な停戦枠組みを生み出すことはないだろうということで概ね一致している。

de.title: Tiefe Schläge, flache Gespräche: Warum Trumps Treffen mit Selenskyj in Ankara Moskau nicht bewegt hat

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Ein symbolischer Händedruck, kein Durchbruch

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: Am Rande des jüngsten NATO-Gipfels in Ankara traf sich Präsident Donald Trump mit dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj zu einem Gespräch, das zwar Schlagzeilen machte, aber laut informierten Beamten wenig in Bezug auf neue Bedingungen hervorbrachte.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Trump stellte die ukrainischen Fernschläge tief in russisches Territorium Berichten zufolge als eine Quelle echten Hebelwirksamkeit auf dem Schlachtfeld dar und deutete an, dass der Druck auf die russische Infrastruktur und Logistik Moskau schließlich an den Verhandlungstisch zwingen könnte, zu Bedingungen, die für Kiew günstiger wären.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Dies war ein bemerkenswerter Tonwechsel eines Präsidenten, der einen Großteil des letzten Jahres damit verbracht hatte, beide Seiten zu einem schnellen Waffenstillstand zu drängen.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Doch laut Diplomaten, die mit den Diskussionen vertraut sind, brachte das Treffen eher Ermutigung als einen konkreten Rahmen – und der Kernstreit, der jeden bisherigen Versuch eines Waffenstillstands zum Scheitern brachte, bleibt unangetastet.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## Der Knackpunkt hat sich nicht geändert

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Dieser Streit betrifft den Status des Donbas.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Russische Unterhändler haben konsequent signalisiert, dass jede dauerhafte Einigung erfordert, dass die Ukraine die verbleibenden unter ukrainischer Kontrolle stehenden Teile von Donezk und Luhansk formell abtritt – Gebiete, die Moskau bereits als annektiert beansprucht, aber militärisch nicht vollständig kontrolliert.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kiew hat diese Forderung ebenso konsequent zurückgewiesen und argumentiert, dass die Aufgabe von nicht besetzten, befestigten Gebieten – einschließlich Städten, die ukrainische Streitkräfte seit Jahren verteidigt haben – sowohl eine verfassungsrechtliche als auch eine strategische rote Linie darstelle.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Analysten, die die Gespräche verfolgen, sagen, dies sei die Bruchlinie, die fast jeden im Jahr 2026 vorgeschlagenen Waffenstillstandsrahmen zum Einsturz gebracht habe, von europäisch vermittelten Vorschlägen bis hin zu informellen Kanälen über Golfstaaten-Vermittler.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Fernschläge, so dramatisch sie auch sein mögen, haben diese Grundgleichung nicht verändert.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: „Druck auf dem Schlachtfeld kann das Tempo der Gespräche verändern“, sagte ein in Europa ansässiger Sicherheitsanalyst.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: „Er hat jedoch nicht die Substanz dessen verändert, was jede Seite als notwendiges Ergebnis ansieht, um den Verhandlungstisch zu verlassen.“

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Warum Schläge allein nicht in Hebelwirkung umschlagen

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: Der erweiterte Einsatz von Ferndrohnen und Raketen durch die Ukraine gegen Raffinerien, Depots und Logistikzentren in Russland hat zweifellos die Kosten für Moskau erhöht und Teile seines Energiesektors gestört.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Trumps Kommentare in Ankara schienen diese Kampagne als legitimes Verhandlungsinstrument zu befürworten, anstatt sie als eine zu vermeidende Eskalation zu betrachten – eine bemerkenswerte Abkehr von früheren White-House-Botschaften, die zur Zurückhaltung bei Schlägen tief in russisches Territorium aufgerufen hatten.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Beamte auf beiden Seiten, sowohl ukrainisch als auch russisch, warnen jedoch davor, zu viel in diesen Wechsel hineinzulesen.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Russische Staatsmedien und Beamte haben das Gipfeltreffen heruntergespielt und die Schläge als Angriffe charakterisiert, die die innenpolitische Entschlossenheit eher stärken als die Verhandlungsposition schwächen.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes kommt

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Bis die Donbas-Frage frontal angegangen wird – durch eine Formel, die beide Regierungen innenpolitisch als vertretbar darstellen können – sind sich Beamte und Analysten weitgehend einig, dass selbst hochkarätige diplomatische Momente wie der in Ankara wahrscheinlich Schlagzeilen produzieren, ohne den dauerhaften Waffenstillstandsrahmen zu schaffen, der den Unterhändlern das ganze Jahr über entgangen ist.

vi.title: Đòn tấn công sâu, Cuộc đối thoại hời hợt: Tại sao cuộc gặp tại Ankara giữa Trump và Zelensky không làm Moscow lay chuyển

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Một cái bắt tay mang tính biểu tượng, không phải một bước đột phá

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: Bên lề hội nghị thượng đỉnh NATO mới nhất tại Ankara, Tổng thống Donald Trump đã ngồi lại với Tổng thống Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky trong một cuộc gặp gỡ tạo ra nhiều tiêu đề báo chí nhưng, theo các quan chức được thông tin về cuộc hội đàm, có rất ít điều khoản mới.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Trump được cho là đã định khung các cuộc tấn công tầm xa của Ukraine sâu vào lãnh thổ Nga như một nguồn đòn bẩy chiến trường thực sự, gợi ý rằng áp lực lên cơ sở hạ tầng và hậu cần của Nga cuối cùng có thể đẩy Moscow về phía bàn đàm phán với các điều khoản có lợi hơn cho Kyiv.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Đó là một sự thay đổi đáng kể về tông giọng từ một vị tổng thống đã dành phần lớn thời gian trong năm qua để thúc giục cả hai bên tiến tới một lệnh ngừng bắn nhanh chóng.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, theo các nhà ngoại giao quen thuộc với các cuộc thảo luận, cuộc gặp đã tạo ra sự khích lệ hơn là một khung làm việc cụ thể — và tranh chấp cốt lõi khiến mọi nỗ lực đình chiến trước đó thất bại vẫn không được giải quyết.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## Điểm nghẽn vẫn không thay đổi

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Tranh chấp đó là tình trạng của vùng Donbas.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Các nhà đàm phán Nga liên tục ra tín hiệu rằng bất kỳ thỏa thuận lâu dài nào cũng yêu cầu Ukraine phải chính thức nhượng lại các phần còn lại của Donetsk và Luhansk do Ukraine nắm giữ, vùng lãnh thổ mà Moscow đã tuyên bố sáp nhập nhưng không kiểm soát hoàn toàn về mặt quân sự.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kyiv cũng liên tục bác bỏ yêu cầu đó, lập luận rằng việc từ bỏ lãnh thổ kiên cố, chưa bị chiếm đóng — bao gồm các thành phố mà lực lượng Ukraine đã bảo vệ trong nhiều năm — sẽ là một lằn ranh đỏ về cả hiến pháp và chiến lược.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích theo dõi các cuộc đàm phán cho biết đây là đường đứt gãy khiến gần như mọi khung ngừng bắn được đưa ra trong năm 2026 bị sụp đổ, từ các đề xuất do châu Âu môi giới đến các kênh không chính thức liên quan đến các nhà trung gian vùng Vịnh.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Các cuộc tấn công tầm xa, dù kịch tính đến đâu, cũng không làm thay đổi phương trình cơ bản đó.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "Áp lực chiến trường có thể thay đổi tốc độ của các cuộc đàm phán," một nhà phân tích an ninh tại châu Âu cho biết.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "Nó không làm thay đổi bản chất của những gì mỗi bên nói rằng họ cần đạt được khi rời bàn đàm phán."

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Tại sao chỉ riêng các cuộc tấn công không chuyển hóa thành đòn bẩy

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: Việc Ukraine mở rộng sử dụng máy bay không người lái và tên lửa tầm xa chống lại các nhà máy lọc dầu, kho bãi và trung tâm hậu cần bên trong nước Nga không thể phủ nhận đã làm tăng chi phí cho Moscow và gây gián đoạn một phần lĩnh vực năng lượng của họ.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Các bình luận của Trump tại Ankara dường như tán thành chiến dịch đó như một công cụ mặc cả hợp pháp thay vì một sự leo thang cần bị ngăn chặn — một sự thay đổi đáng kể so với các thông điệp trước đó của Nhà Trắng thúc giục kiềm chế trong các cuộc tấn công sâu vào lãnh thổ Nga.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Nhưng các quan chức từ cả phía Ukraine và Nga đều cảnh báo không nên suy diễn quá nhiều về sự thay đổi này.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Truyền thông nhà nước Nga và các quan chức đã hạ thấp tầm quan trọng của cuộc gặp thượng đỉnh, mô tả các cuộc tấn công là những cuộc tấn công làm cứng rắn thêm quyết tâm trong nước thay vì làm yếu đi vị thế đàm phán.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: Các phát ngôn viên của Điện Kremlin đã nhắc lại rằng các vấn đề lãnh thổ là "điểm khởi đầu không thể thương lượng", không phải là những đề nghị mở đầu tùy thuộc vào đà tiến của chiến trường.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, các quan chức Ukraine đã hoan nghênh sự ủng hộ về mặt ngôn từ của Trump nhưng cẩn thận không nói quá về ý nghĩa thực tế của nó.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: Kyiv tiếp tục tìm kiếm các đảm bảo an ninh chắc chắn hơn — các cam kết tương tự NATO hoặc các hiệp ước phòng thủ song phương — như một điều kiện cho bất kỳ sự thỏa hiệp về lãnh thổ nào, một yêu cầu mà cho đến nay vẫn chưa tìm thấy sự đồng thuận giữa các đồng minh.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì sẽ diễn ra tiếp theo

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, cuộc gặp tại Ankara dường như đóng vai trò như một tín hiệu về sự liên kết giữa Washington và Kyiv hơn là khởi đầu của một lộ trình đàm phán mới.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: Các nhà ngoại giao cho biết các cuộc đàm phán tiếp theo có khả năng diễn ra trong những tuần tới, có thể bao gồm các trung gian châu Âu và Thổ Nhĩ Kỳ, những người đã tổ chức các vòng tiếp xúc gián tiếp trước đó giữa các phái đoàn Nga và Ukraine.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Cho đến khi vấn đề Donbas được giải quyết trực diện — thông qua một công thức mà cả hai chính phủ có thể trình bày là có thể bảo vệ được ở trong nước — các quan chức và nhà phân tích nhìn chung đồng ý rằng ngay cả những khoảnh khắc ngoại giao cao cấp như cuộc gặp tại Ankara cũng có khả năng chỉ tạo ra các tiêu đề báo chí mà không tạo ra được khung ngừng bắn bền vững mà các nhà đàm phán đã tìm kiếm trong suốt năm qua.
